draft_metadata.description: For every integer m >= 1, with N=m(m+1)/2 and staircase rho=(m,...,1), the specified orbit of v_R tensor v_R tensor v_C in the integral Specht tensor cube has an explicit integral G-linear left inverse and yields a regular Z[G] direct summand. The split maps extend to every commutative unital ring, including nonflat extensions and the zero ring. The paper credits the classical separating-functional/product criterion, triangular uniqueness, pinned square-deficit mechanism, and earlier complex/modular antecedents. Separate independently reviewed Lean support proves conditional finite-coordinate splitting and preservation of given split maps under arbitrary scalar extension; the full staircase theorem is not formalized.
draft_metadata.title: An integral regular summand in every staircase Specht tensor cube
